ABOUT PLOTMARK

A focused AI product.
A clearly defined buyer.

For property developers and land acquisition teams. Plotmark reads title papers, survey plans and planning documents, then lists missing evidence and conflicting parcel details with page references.

Illustrative operating context · licensed photography
THE BUSINESS IDEA

AI compares land documents and survey references before an acquisition review.

An acquisition file can include hundreds of scanned pages and several versions of a survey. The AI must read the pages, match parcel references and compare conflicting details across the file.

Who buys it
Property developers & acquisition teams
What they send in
Title papers, survey plans and planning documents
What they receive
A parcel review brief with document conflicts and missing evidence
How it is sold
A B2B subscription with a defined processing allowance.
OWNERSHIP & PRODUCT STATUS

Clear about the
business behind the page.

Plotmark is an MVP product concept developed for Uniqkode. The website and review tools work; prepared case data demonstrates the intended AI workflow. A live model account and production identity service are not connected by default.

Customer endorsements, paid-user counts and company registration details have not been supplied. This website makes no claim that an unrelated company uses the product or that a registered legal entity operates it.
